title: CPL Live Score 2026: Today's Match, Scorecard & Results
description: Follow today's CPL live score with runs, wickets, overs, toss, playing XIs, ball-by-ball updates, full scorecards, fixtures and CPL 2026 results.
headline: CPL Live Score 2026
lede: Follow the CPL 2026 live score, ball-by-ball updates, fixtures and results from every match.
source_note: Scores update automatically during play. If an update is delayed, the latest match score stays on screen.

faq.question: How often does the CPL live score update?
faq.answer: The page updates automatically during play. New runs, wickets and overs appear as match updates become available.

faq.question: Where can I find today's CPL match score?
faq.answer: The current-match panel at the top of this page shows today's CPL fixture, live score, overs and match status. Before play begins, it shows the start time, venue and countdown.

faq.question: Does the page show the toss and playing XI?
faq.answer: Yes. The toss result and confirmed playing XIs appear when they become available. Before the toss, those fields remain clearly marked as pending.

faq.question: Where can I view the full CPL scorecard?
faq.answer: Select View full scorecard in the current-match panel. The match page includes innings details and the ball-by-ball match-centre view.
